existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Copy fee limited to reasonable direct cost
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A public body may charge a fee only to recover the reasonable, direct costs of record copying or mechanical reproduction.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Body charges a copy fee (non-commercial, non-disruptive request).
existing_fee_payment_rules.clock_spec: ceiling: reasonable direct cost of copying/reproduction
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Otherwise, a public body may charge a fee only for recovery of the reasonable, direct costs of record copying, or mechanical reproduction.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Maps to dictionary key fee.copy_actual_cost_ceiling__1 (CA/VA/WA). Search/labor cost is NOT recoverable except in the two circumstances in OK-0019.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The record copying fee may not exceed twenty-five cents ($0.25) per page for records 8.5 by 14 inches or smaller.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Body charges a per-page copy fee for standard-size pages.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Notwithstanding any state or local provision to the contrary, in no instance shall the record copying fee exceed twenty-five cents ($0.25) per page for records having the dimensions of eight and one-half (8 1/2) by fourteen (14) inches or smaller,
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Maps to dictionary key fee.per_page_rate_ceiling__1 (NY/FL/IL/WA). 'Notwithstanding any state or local provision to the contrary' pre-empts higher local rates for standard requests.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The fee for a certified copy may not exceed One Dollar ($1.00) per copied page.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: or a maximum of One Dollar ($1.00) per copied page for a certified copy.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Search fee permitted only for commercial or excessively-disruptive requests
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: If a request is solely for a commercial purpose, or would clearly cause excessive disruption of the body's essential functions, the body may charge a reasonable fee to recover the direct cost of record search and copying.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Request is solely for commercial purpose OR would clearly cause excessive disruption of essential functions.
existing_fee_payment_rules.clock_spec: ceiling: reasonable direct cost of search and copying
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: However, if the request: a. is solely for commercial purpose, or b. would clearly cause excessive disruption of the essential functions of the public body, then the public body may charge a reasonable fee to recover the direct cost of record search and copying;
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: New coined key fee.search_fee_conditional. Structural because it is a fee-basis fork gated by request classification (commercial purpose is a definition the software branches on — keeper-sliver). Search-fee recovery is otherwise prohibited (contrast OK-0016).

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: News-media use is not a commercial purpose
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Newspaper publication or news-media broadcast for news purposes is not a resale or commercial/trade use, and charges for electronic data provided to news media for a news purpose may not exceed the direct cost of copying.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Requester is news media using the record for a news purpose.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: however, publication in a newspaper or broadcast by news media for news purposes shall not constitute a resale or use of a record for trade or commercial purpose and charges for providing copies of electronic data to the news media for a news purpose shall not exceed the direct cost of making the copy.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: New coined key classification.commercial_purpose_news_exclusion. Definition the software branches on: prevents news-media requests from triggering the commercial-purpose search fee (OK-0019).

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A public body that establishes fees must post a written schedule of the fees at its principal office and with the county clerk.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Body establishes fees under the Act.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Any public body establishing fees under this act shall post a written schedule of the fees at its principal office and with the county clerk.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: New coined key fee.schedule_posting. A precondition to charging fees.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: No search fee when release is in the public interest
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: No search fee may be charged when release of the records is in the public interest, including release to news media, scholars, authors, and taxpayers seeking to determine whether officials are performing their duties.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Release of records is in the public interest.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: In no case shall a search fee be charged when the release of records is in the public interest, including, but not limited to, release to the news media, scholars, authors and taxpayers seeking to determine whether those entrusted with the affairs of the government are honestly, faithfully, and competently performing their duties as public servants.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Maps to dictionary key fee.waiver_public_interest__1 (TX/IL). Overrides the search-fee permission (OK-0019) for public-interest requests.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Fees not to be used to discourage requests
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Fees may not be used to discourage requests for information or as obstacles to disclosure of requested information.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The fees shall not be used for the purpose of discouraging requests for information or as obstacles to disclosure of requested information;
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: New coined key fee.no_discouragement. Anti-obstruction constraint on fee-setting.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Per-record fee where prescribed by other state law
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Where the cost of copying/reproducing/certifying each individual record is otherwise prescribed by state law, the body may assess that cost per individual record or portion requested.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Request contains individual records whose copy/certification cost is set by another state statute.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Any request for a record which contains individual records of persons, and the cost of copying, reproducing or certifying each individual record is otherwise prescribed by state law, the cost may be assessed for each individual record, or portion thereof requested as prescribed by state law.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: New coined key fee.statutory_per_record. A branch to externally-prescribed fee schedules that displaces the $0.25/page cap.
